system.description: Use this Skill to make generic, mundane items with no inherent bonuses wholly out of Misc. Junk, but your GM can give them situational bonuses. Examples include a ladder, a 50ft rope, or a ceramic pot to store napalm. For items with moving parts, see the Engineering Skill instead. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you create the item.

upgrades.description: Choose a mundane item to specialize in. You have Advantage when creating that item.
You may craft your specialty item with a +1 bonus level enchantment.
You may craft your specialty item with up to +2 bonus level enchantment, and it takes half the time.

system.limitations: Cannot create things with moving parts, fluids, or chemicals.
